entities.name: ReviewPipeline
observations: 2026-06-23: Resumsify phase-end review architecture. Three-column cost-tiered design: Column 1 (OSS deterministic, ~170s, BUILT at commit 4d5d08d), Column 2 (local LLM chain via Cline + gemma4:26b + codegraph MCP + slice manifests, NOT BUILT), Column 3 (premium Copilot Opus/Sonnet escalation flag, NOT BUILT). Captured in ADR-0047.

2026-06-23: Column 1 entry point is `npm run review:phase`. Implementation at scripts/review-phase.mjs. Re-runs tsc / eslint / knip / madge / vitest, parses structured counts, diffs against docs/review-baseline.json. Exit 0 = clean, 1 = regression, 2 = infra/parser failure.

2026-06-23: Regression policy — strict by default (any gate count > baseline → exit 1); `--accept-net` flag allows per-gate regressions if total across gates didn't grow; `vitest.failed > 0` is a hard fail in ALL modes (no opt-out).

2026-06-23: Baseline lives at docs/review-baseline.json (versioned, includes commit SHA + capturedAt ISO timestamp). Regenerate via `npm run review:baseline` after landing intentional improvements. Initial baseline captured at ef75099: tsc 22 errors / eslint 495 errors + 10591 warnings / knip 0/0/0 / madge 0 circular / vitest 966 passed + 5 skipped + 0 failed (971 total).

2026-06-23: Ship rhythm upgraded — E→T→C became E→T→R→C with R = column 1 today; columns 2-3 plug in later under the same baseline contract. R is REQUIRED for phase-end / pre-push / ADR-shipping / cross-cutting changes (libs / schemas / types / config). R is OPTIONAL (T still required) for single-file UI tweaks / doc-only commits / scratch experiments. Gate is slow (~170s) — budget for it but don't skip on the work that matters.

2026-06-23: Three-stage chain within column 2 (designed, not built): verify → categorize → act. Verify-first build order to de-risk hallucinated findings before adding the action loop. First prototype target: worklog-editor slice (highest existing knownTrap surface in docs/c-yard/).

2026-06-23: Red-team verified — injecting one `any` annotation in an unused src/lib/ file triggers exit 1 with both eslint (+1) and knip (+1) flagging the regression independently. Removing the file restores exit 0. Gate has teeth.
2026-06-23: Workflow recipe at docs/workflows/setup-phase-end-review-gate.md for bootstrapping equivalent gates in future repos or recalibrating after major lint/type churn.

2026-06-23: Column 2 verify-stage PROTOTYPE LANDED at commit eeedc3e. Stack: gemma4:26b via Ollama HTTP (http://localhost:11434/api/generate) + format:json + num_ctx:16384 + num_predict:2000 + temperature:0.1. Entry point: `npm run review:semantic -- --slice <slug>`. Output: docs/review-semantic/<slug>-<sha>.json (incremental writes; status: in-progress→complete for crash recovery). Files: scripts/lib/semantic-prompt.mjs (prompt + Ollama caller, ~95 LOC), scripts/review-semantic.mjs (orchestrator + strict validator, ~340 LOC). Advisory exit 0 in v1.

2026-06-23: Column 2 v1 baseline (worklog-editor slice @ 6916435): 19 traps in 502s, 3 still-valid / 0 stale (real) / 14 dropped. Spot-check confirms 0 real drift detected — slice is current. False-positive STALE rate: 2/19 (both caused by model confusion or cross-file scope mismatch, NOT real drift).

2026-06-23: v2 prompt pattern (validated 2026-06-23 positive + negative control): mandatory comparisonChecklist field with 2+ items + CRITICAL BIAS framing (false positives worse than false negatives) + STEP 1/2/3 reasoning procedure. Strict validator rejects stillValid=true if ANY checklist item has matchedInCode=false (prevents model self-contradiction rubber-stamping). gemma4:26b can self-contradict (evidence prose disagrees with checklist) — validator's consistency check catches this.

2026-06-23: Column 2 v1 KNOWN LIMITATIONS: (a) Cross-file traps unverifiable — when knownTrap describes behavior in files OTHER than entryPoint.primaryPath, model returns lineRef=null and trap is dropped (3/19 traps in baseline). v2 should split multi-file traps into per-file anchors. (b) stillValid=false conflates real drift with model anchoring failure — reviewers must read evidence + checklist before trusting STALE. (c) 8192 num_ctx overflows on >400-line files (silent ~empty JSON). 16384 fits current slice; v2 may need adaptive ctx-sizing. (d) num_predict cap required to prevent runaway generation hangs.

2026-06-23: Column 2 retry policy — 1 retry per trap on parse error / validation failure / Ollama HTTP error. 120s AbortController timeout per call. Worst-case per trap: 240s. Validation rules: comparisonChecklist length>=2, each item has claim+matchedInCode(bool)+lineRef(in range 1..fileLineCount)+note, stillValid in {true,false,'ambiguous'}, citedLines non-empty all in range, category in {mechanical,semantic,ambiguous}, evidence non-empty.

2026-06-24: Tier A enforcement layer shipped (commit 7c7202a, ADR-0048). Three additions on TOP of the existing three columns: (1) lefthook pre-push hook runs `npm run review:phase` automatically — closes 'forgot to test' failure mode; (2) Semgrep Community + 3 seed slice-trap rules wired as hard-fail pre-step inside review-phase.mjs (no-window-prompt WARNING for 56-callsite debt; no-radix-onselect ERROR; no-dropdown-trigger-onclick ERROR); (3) Dependabot for npm + GitHub Actions ecosystems. Activates only on push to remote (no-push session 2026-06-24 deferred activation).

2026-06-24: Semgrep cross-platform install pattern: `python -m pipx install semgrep` installs to ~/.local/bin (NOT on Windows PATH by default). Wrapper at scripts/review-semgrep.mjs resolves via PATH → ~/.local/bin/semgrep.exe → ~/.local/pipx/venvs/semgrep/Scripts/semgrep.exe. Use `languages: [typescript]` (NOT [tsx] — Semgrep rejects). Glob patterns must prefix with `**/` (e.g. `**/src/**/*.tsx`) for unanchored Semgrepignore-v2 behaviour.

2026-06-24: Slice traps codified as Semgrep rules become deterministic Column 1 gates that fire repo-wide for free, freeing Column 2 LLM cost for novel-semantic issues. Each rule starts as WARNING if existing debt would flood the gate, then promoted to ERROR after debt cleanup — single-line edit `severity: WARNING` → `severity: ERROR` permanently locks out the bug class.

2026-06-24: Re-baseline `npm run review:baseline` is required after wiring Semgrep IF baseline has drifted since last update. Today: baseline jumped ef75099 → 7c7202a; tsc 22→29, eslint 495→519, knip.deps 0→1 captured as new floor (drift was pre-existing debt, not Tier A side-effects).

2026-06-24: Tiers B/C/D explicitly deferred with re-entry triggers in /memories/repo/parked-ideas.md `Review pipeline — Tiers B/C/D` entry. B = coverage gate / trailer enforcement / weekly review-queue stub / WARNING→ERROR promotions / Semgrep --baseline-commit mode. C = group-coordination tools rejected for solo-dev (CodeRabbit/Greptile/CI/branch protection/SonarQube). D = observability/dashboards (data-bottleneck triggers). Don't re-litigate the C rejection — it's structural, not preference.

2026-06-24: Workflow recipe at docs/workflows/add-review-enforcement-layer.md covers adding a lefthook hook, Semgrep rule, or Dependabot ecosystem. Captures the 5 first-attempt failures (semgrep tsx-language reject, glob-prefix warnings, pipx-PATH cross-platform, lefthook auto-template, re-baseline requirement).

2026-06-24: ETRC rhythm shipped (commits e739ef8 + 139d1e5, ratified by ADR-0049). E→T→C user-memory pattern upgraded to E→T→[auto-classify]→R-if-risky→C. Post-commit lefthook hook runs scripts/review-log.mjs (mechanical classifier + JSONL queue append). For risky-tier commits ONLY, spawns scripts/review-r-local.mjs detached so git commit returns instantly; gemma4:26b runs a design-only check in background (~30-120s) and appends a separate type:review line to the queue. Reader at scripts/review-queue-read.mjs joins commit+review entries by full SHA, tier-filterable for review-day. Hard contract: hook NEVER blocks the commit; all failure modes (ollama down, empty response, malformed SHA) land as queue entries with skipped:reason results.

2026-06-24: ETRC tier heuristics (mechanical, no LLM in classifier): risky = prisma/schema.prisma | migrations | src/app/api/ | src/lib/auth* | src/middleware* | .github/instructions/ | package.json | diff > 300 LOC | src/lib|src/data without tests added (TDD-intersect soft signal). trivial = docs-only | chore(scripts|deps) under LOC | single-file under 30 LOC. standard = everything else. Validated against today's 7-commit session: 2/7 (28%) tagged risky, exactly the surface that warrants R attention (Tier A ship + schema migration). Always commit-and-queue; no fix-in-loop branch (atomicity wins).

2026-06-24: ETRC first-attempt failures (captured for posterity): (1) Windows cmd.exe eats `^` in `${sha}^{commit}` git refs via PowerShell execSync shell=true — drop the suffix entirely for plain SHAs. (2) lefthook `{ref}` template only resolves for pre-push/pre-receive, NOT post-commit — pass no arg and let the script default to HEAD. (3) gemma4:26b v1 R-prompt emitting skipped:empty-response on both today's risky commits (small structural diffs with no clear improvement opportunity). Hard contract held; v2 prompt tuning is parked work after 5-10 risky commits of data accumulate.

2026-06-24: ETRC queue file (docs/review-queue.jsonl) is gitignored — per-machine review-day data, not project source. Like workflow-change-log.json shape (append-only JSONL). Review-day workflow: `npm run review:queue --tier risky` for deep attention, `--tier standard` for 1-in-3 spot check, `--tier trivial` for glance-only classifier-sanity. `npm run review:escalate <sha>` formats a premium-subagent prompt for manual paste — no automatic premium invocation; user decides per-SHA when tokens are worth it.

2026-06-24: Workflow recipe at docs/workflows/etrc-rhythm.md captures the rhythm end-to-end (day-to-day usage, review-day flow, adding new risky-tier triggers, tuning R-local prompt). Promotion candidates in ADR-0049: v2 R-prompt tuning, TDD-intersect hard-block ratchet (lefthook pre-commit refusing src/lib|src/data|src/app/api commits without matching test files), classifier escape-hatch trailer `Review-Tier: x`, queue auto-rotation.

2026-06-24: Tier B sprint shipped (3 commits, ETRC-disciplined). B5 (66887ea): Semgrep `--baseline-commit` mode added to scripts/review-semgrep.mjs — when env var `RESUMSIFY_REVIEW_BASELINE_COMMIT` is set, semgrep runs with `--baseline-commit <sha>` and only NEW findings since that commit fail the gate. Pre-existing debt (56 window-prompt callsites) no longer blocks the gate. With baseline-commit in place, `semgrep/rules/no-window-prompt.yml` promoted WARNING → ERROR — the bug class is now architecturally locked out for NEW code while the historic debt drains organically.

2026-06-24: Tier B sprint B1 (7ab910a): per-folder coverage gate added to review:phase. `@vitest/coverage-v8` v4.1.9 installed. vitest.config.ts gained coverage.reporter=['text','json-summary'], coverage.reportsDirectory='coverage', and provider='v8'. scripts/review-phase.mjs now reads coverage/coverage-summary.json after vitest pass and enforces per-folder floors via `coverage` field in docs/review-baseline.json. Hard-fail (no --accept-net offset), exit 1 if any folder's pct drops below baseline. Initial floor at commit 66887ea: src/lib=48.06% / src/app/api=10.59% / src/data=0%. Total baseline grew tsc 22→29, eslint 495→519, knip.deps 0→1, vitest 966/5/971 → 1017/5/1022 across Tier A+B; per-folder coverage now part of the contract.

2026-06-24: Tier B sprint B3 thin (0b98016): `npm run review:queue --since <X>` shorthand extended beyond ISO date. Three-case dispatch in scripts/review-queue-read.mjs `resolveSinceTs()`: relative duration (`/^(\d+)\s*(d|days?|w|weeks?)$/i` — `7days`, `30d`, `2weeks`, `2w`), git SHA (`/^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i` resolved via `spawnSync('git', ['log', '-1', '--format=%cI', sha])` — cutoff = that commit's committer date), and ISO/`Date.parse()` fallback (back-compat). Graceful failure: malformed input emits stderr warning and skips the filter (does NOT silently include everything). Resolved cutoff label printed in header (`Filter: since=7days (cutoff: 2026-06-17T23:16:42.222Z)`). docs/workflows/etrc-rhythm.md review-day cadence reframed around `--since 7days` weekly window; prompt-tuning section flipped to `--since 30days`.

2026-06-24: Tier B parked-ideas re-entry triggers honored — B4 (window-prompt cleanup sprint) explicitly NOT opened per anti-recommendation (Semgrep WARNING + B5 baseline-commit gate already prevent NEW occurrences; cleanup is opportunistic per-file). B2 (commit-msg trailer enforcement) skipped — trigger 'forget to add a relevant trailer twice' not yet fired. B trio of B5+B1+B3-thin shipped as three separate ETRC commits per parked-ideas.md re-entry discipline line 73 ('Don't bundle multiple items into one commit'). Tier C explicitly NOT picked up — all five items (CodeRabbit/Greptile, GitHub Actions CI, branch protection, SonarQube/CodeQL, Reviewable) gated on either second-contributor or paid-audit triggers that have not fired; rejection is structural per parked-ideas.md line 72.
